reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent source-semantic review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP and Radare2 6.2.0 on retail igi.exe; candidate translation unit recompiled with the repository -O3 flags.
review_basis: The current engine/src/retail/script/script_mode.cpp hashes to 5e9c5f3afd9aa309fb3875631cf93bac0006a6b08c2b488e6208ec650b87211b. The retail entry was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view and independently recovered with Radare2; both graphs are recorded in the referenced evidence files and agree at 1.000 on nodes and edges. The candidate source and its compiled object symbol were then read against that reconstruction. This review supersedes the earlier evidence that was stale against the current source digest.
